answer: Peer-audit bond stops bulk fakes: each locks 70 credits and files one claim in the karst ledger. Each epoch three random peers audit it and replay the relic's provenance. Shared relic, copied sable seal, or missing provenance burns the bond. Each fake pays 105 (70 locked, 35 fee): 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 65,000 loss. A rented-audit ring fails: auditors are drawn fresh each epoch. Honest agents pay 35 once, keep their stake.
